definitions.name: \(\overline N_S\)
definitions.construction: Form \(L_S(x)=H_S+\operatorname{span}_{\mathbb F_S}\{r_c(x)\}\), take \(N_S(x)=L_S(x)^\perp\), and set \(\overline N_S=(N_S(x)+J_S)/J_S\subseteq E_S/J_S\).

definitions.name: \(\eta(S)\)
definitions.construction: Replicate each quotient block image \(W_y\) exactly \(u-1\) times, and set \(\eta(S)=\max_{I\subseteq\mathcal D_S}\{|I|-\dim_{\mathbb F_S}(\sum_{(y,j)\in I}W_y)\}\).

definitions.name: \(\Theta_S\)
definitions.construction: \(\Theta_S=\{(p,(\Pi_y)_y):p_s>0,\ \sum_{s\in S}p_s=1,\ \Pi_y\mathbf 1_u=\mathbf 1_{\mathcal B_y},\ \Pi_y>0\text{ entrywise for every }y\in\mathcal I_S\}\).

definitions.name: \(\mathcal O_S\)
definitions.construction: Given \(I\subseteq\mathcal D_S\), return \(\dim_{\mathbb F_S}(\sum_{(y,j)\in I}W_y)\) by exact Gaussian elimination over \(\mathbb F_S\) on matrices representing \(D_S\), \(r_c(x)\), \(J_S\), and the selected block embeddings.

definitions.name: \(\mathfrak U_S\)
definitions.construction: For supports satisfying the quotient Hall inequalities, express the full-size minors of \(M_\theta\) in positive simplex coordinates, factor their common determinantal ideal by support-incidence components, and test whether a subtraction-free minor or a positive-domain common-zero certificate exists.

statements.statement: For every \(\theta\in\Theta_S\), multiplication by \(p_\theta\) maps the fortified conditional-mean-zero functions bijectively onto the specialization of \(H_S\) and maps \(L^2(C)\) onto the specialization of \(R_S(x)\). Consequently, \(\operatorname{rank}M_\theta\) equals the rank of the composite block-column map \(\bigoplus_{y\in\mathcal I_S}\mathbb R^u\xrightarrow{\oplus_y\Pi_{\theta,y}}\mathbb R^S\to\mathbb R^S/N_S(p_\theta)\).
statements.justification: This reduction removes law-dependent denominators and exposes the structural-zero problem as a product of block-subspace choices.
statements.gap: Yu, Shi, and Tchetgen Tchetgen define the fortified conditional moments, but their finite illustration does not derive a support-incidence representation with heterogeneous alphabets and structural zeros.
statements.consumer: The reduction gives a law-independent input to the Hall certificate and prevents a rank failure caused by support from being mistaken for weak association at one law.

statements.statement: After one constant column is separated in every row-stochastic block, let the remaining \(u-1\) contrast columns range independently in \(\overline V_y\). The maximum rank of their images in \(\overline E_S/\overline N_S\) is \(|\mathcal D_S|-\eta(S)\). The maximizing contrast array lies in a nonempty Zariski-open set and has a rational representative; sufficiently small rational perturbation of the uniform row-stochastic blocks realizes it with strictly positive entries.
statements.justification: This is the early kill test and the mathematical hinge converting local structural zeros into an exact global rank loss.
statements.gap: Rado characterizes independent representatives from prescribed subspaces, while the fortified problem requires simultaneous subspace choices, repeated latent contrasts, a block-constant quotient, and rational positive realization.
statements.consumer: The theorem supplies the missing attainment step needed by every support-specific completeness diagnostic in the proposal.

statements.statement: There exists \(\theta_0\in\Theta_S\) with rational positive entries such that \(\operatorname{rank}M_{\theta_0}=Q_S-\kappa_0(S)-\eta(S)\). Moreover, \(r_{\mathrm{gen}}(S)=Q_S-\kappa_0(S)-\eta(S)\), and the same rank holds on a nonempty relative Zariski-open, Euclidean-dense, full-Lebesgue-measure subset of \(\Theta_S\). If \(\kappa_0(S)+\eta(S)>0\), then \(\operatorname{rank}M_\theta<Q_S\) for every \(\theta\in\Theta_S\).
statements.justification: The formula separates forced constant-direction loss from the genuine quotient Hall defect and converts an abstract rank upper bound into compatible positive tables.
statements.gap: Miao, Geng, and Tchetgen Tchetgen require categorical proxy rank, and the banked rectangular result treats equal alphabets with full support; neither gives rank from an arbitrary declared support.
statements.consumer: An analyst can determine whether the fortified outcome-completeness route is generically feasible or impossible at every compatible positive law before fitting bridge models.

statements.statement: The fortified pairing has generic full row rank if and only if \(\kappa_0(S)=0\) and \(\dim_{\mathbb F_S}(\sum_{(y,j)\in I}W_y)\ge|I|\) for every \(I\subseteq\mathcal D_S\). Equivalently, generic full row rank holds if and only if \(\kappa_0(S)=0\) and \(\eta(S)=0\). Failure of either condition is a law-uniform failure of this pairing route, not a claim that \(\tau\) is unidentified.
statements.justification: The all-subfamilies inequalities are the exact structural-support frontier rather than a global supply-versus-demand count.
statements.gap: Published proximal rank conditions are law-level conditions, and generic partitioned-matrix theorems allow different parameter dependence than the stochastic product blocks here.
statements.consumer: The frontier gives a deficient subset of treatment-by-complement blocks that explains why an apparently adequate aggregate alphabet cannot support fortified completeness.

statements.statement: Given \(S\), \(u\), and the quotient rank oracle, a strongly polynomial submodular-function-minimization algorithm returns \(\kappa_0(S)\), \(\eta(S)\), \(r_{\mathrm{gen}}(S)\), and a maximizing deficient set \(I^*\subseteq\mathcal D_S\) using a number of oracle calls polynomial in \(|\mathcal D_S|\). Each oracle call is an exact rank computation over \(\mathbb F_S\); hence the output is an exact certificate rather than a numerical generic-rank guess.
statements.justification: The theorem turns exponentially many Hall inequalities into an executable exact certificate with a named obstruction.
statements.gap: Schrijver supplies oracle submodular minimization and Hirai and Iwamasa handle a narrow independently parameterized block-matrix class; neither constructs the fortified quotient rank oracle.
statements.consumer: Sensitivity analyses over defended proxy subsets can report the precise support blocks responsible for route failure instead of only a failed matrix-rank check.

statements.statement: If \(m_i=m\) for every \(i\), \(S=\{0,1\}\times\mathcal Z\), and \(|\alpha|=\gamma\), then \(Q_S=2u m^{K-\gamma}\) and \(Q_S-\kappa_0(S)-\eta(S)=\min\{Q_S,D_{K,m}(\gamma)\}\), where \(D_{K,m}(\gamma)=m^K+\sum_{j=K-\gamma+1}^K\binom Kj(m-1)^j+m^{K-\gamma}\). Thus the Hall frontier reduces exactly to \(D_{K,m}(\gamma)\ge Q_S\).
statements.justification: This reduction checks that the support theorem contains the banked rectangular result rather than replacing it with an unrelated analogue.
statements.gap: The prior proposal proves only this symmetric full-support boundary and explicitly leaves heterogeneous alphabets and structural zeros unresolved.
statements.consumer: Existing full-support applications retain their arithmetic diagnostic, while sparse-support applications gain the strictly finer Hall certificate.

statements.statement: Among supports with \(\kappa_0(S)=\eta(S)=0\), characterize exactly those \(S\) for which \(\operatorname{rank}M_\theta=Q_S\) for every \(\theta\in\Theta_S\), and for every remaining support construct a strictly positive compatible one-parameter family crossing the determinantal exceptional locus while keeping support \(S\) fixed.
statements.justification: Generic feasibility does not certify completeness at the actual law, so the uniform frontier is the principal open content beyond the generic rank theorem.
statements.gap: Allman, Matias, and Rhodes separate generic from global identifiability for latent product models, but no support-only classification is available for fortified proximal pairing matrices.
statements.consumer: A uniform-support certificate would justify completeness without an unobservable law-specific rank premise; an exceptional-family certificate would identify where actual-law diagnostics remain indispensable.

sampling_model.design: An observational finite-proxy structural causal model with declared support \(S\) and factor-table parameter \(\theta\in\Theta_S\).
sampling_model.units: Independent draws from one compatible law \(P_\theta\); sampling inference is not part of the rank kernel.
sampling_model.overlap: Every cell in \(S\) and every latent state conditional on that cell has strictly positive probability; cells outside \(S\) are structural zeros.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: No nuisance estimator is assumed. The proposal characterizes algebraic feasibility of the fortified completeness premise, not estimation of \(h\).

estimand_functional: \(\tau=\mathbb E\{h(W,1)-h(W,0)\}\) when a fortified outcome bridge exists and the actual-law proximal assumptions hold

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Fortified completeness identifies the average treatment effect when at least \(\gamma\) candidate treatment proxies are valid.
Two categorical proxies identify causal effects when the relevant observed conditional-probability matrix has sufficient rank.
A family has an independent transversal if and only if every subfamily satisfies the corresponding rank inequality.
Algebraic arguments establish generic identifiability for several finite latent product models outside exceptional varieties.
A combinatorial polynomial-time algorithm computes symbolic rank for generic partitioned matrices with \(2\times2\) coefficient blocks.
A minimax rank theorem applies to a restricted class of generic partitioned matrices.

tldr: Fortified proximal identification assumes an injective pairing between latent demand functions and a restricted supply of moments, but structural zeros make aggregate alphabet counts unreliable. The proposed Hall defect \(\eta(S)\), after removing the unavoidable block-constant loss \(\kappa_0(S)\), gives the exact generic rank \(Q_S-\kappa_0(S)-\eta(S)\) on the compatible positive factor-table model. All quotient Hall inequalities are necessary and sufficient for generic full rank, their failure rules out this completeness route at every compatible law, and an exact submodular rank-oracle algorithm returns both the rank and a deficient-block certificate. Generic feasibility is kept distinct from completeness at the actual law and from identification of \(\tau\).

project_justification.gap: Finite proximal theory states categorical rank or completeness conditions at a law, while the fortified many-proxy theory supplies no support-pattern characterization. The banked rectangular result covers only equal alphabets and full support, where transitivity collapses all local obstructions to one dimension count.
project_justification.niche: A declared structural support creates a family of unequal treatment-by-complement blocks. After quotienting block constants, their latent contrasts form an independent-transversal problem, but the representatives must be realized simultaneously by positive stochastic factor tables.
project_justification.fill: The paper derives the support-incidence null quotient, proves the product-block Rado attainment and rational specialization, obtains the exact Hall frontier and law-uniform failure certificate, and supplies an exact submodular oracle algorithm.

related_work: Yu, Shi, and Tchetgen Tchetgen formulate fortified bridge moments and use fortified completeness for average-treatment-effect identification; their setup is the destination problem and not a theorem-level comparator. Miao, Geng, and Tchetgen Tchetgen provide the categorical matrix-rank foundation, without a structural-zero support theorem. Rado supplies the independent-transversal rank inequalities adapted after the block-null quotient. Iwata and Murota and Hirai and Iwamasa study generic partitioned matrices with independently generic scalar blocks, whereas the present matrices arise from positive row-stochastic product blocks and symbolic cell weights. Allman, Matias, and Rhodes supply the nonvanishing-minor logic and the distinction between generic and global identification. Wang and Kuo show why support-sensitive compatibility must be imposed before conditional tables represent a joint law. Schrijver supplies the exact submodular-minimization engine. Cui and coauthors and Zhang and coauthors clarify that completeness is a route premise and that bridge nonuniqueness need not imply failure of the causal functional.
technical_internal_limitation: The inherited claims about one nine-cell example and \(135\) binary cases were not used as evidence because the supplied discovery artifact did not specify the exact support encoding or provide a reproducible script. The proposal instead exposes the symbolic rank oracle and requires every computational exhibit to record \(S\), \(\alpha\), \(u\), \(D_S\), \(\kappa_0(S)\), and a maximizing Hall-deficient set.
honest_scope: The generic-rank, Hall-frontier, rational-attainment, and exact-oracle claims are theorem targets. The classification of supports with law-uniform full rank remains open. Even when the Hall frontier certifies generic feasibility, completeness must still hold at the actual law, a fortified bridge must exist, and the remaining proximal causal assumptions are required before \(\tau\) is identified. When the frontier fails, only this fortified outcome-pairing route is ruled out; another bridge route or target-invariance argument may remain valid. Under full rectangular support with common alphabet size, the result must reduce to the banked arithmetic rank theorem.

seed_details.seed: Exact product-block Hall defect for fortified completeness on declared supports.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the rectangular transitive block-avoidance lemma by an independent-transversal calculation in \(\overline E_S/\overline N_S\), then lift the chosen contrasts through positive stochastic tables.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may call the formula immediate from Rado because the Hall inequalities already characterize independent representatives.
seed_details.rebuttal: Rado does not supply the support-incidence quotient, the forced constant loss, simultaneous block-Grassmannian attainment, positive stochastic realization, or rational specialization on the compatible factor model.

seed_details.seed: Exact submodular rank oracle with a deficient-block certificate.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Show that quotient projection rank is an exact submodular value oracle before invoking strongly polynomial submodular minimization.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may call this a direct invocation of generic submodular-function minimization.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nontrivial object is the rational-function quotient rank oracle and its deficient support certificate; published partitioned-matrix algorithms do not represent the fortified stochastic product blocks.

seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace a single nonvanishing minor by a positive-domain determinantal-ideal analysis that decides whether rank failure can occur anywhere in \(\Theta_S\).
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may object that positivity never removes a determinant-zero set, so uniformity is generically impossible.
seed_details.rebuttal: Some support patterns yield subtraction-free or triangular minors that are nonzero throughout the positive domain, while others admit cancellation; the support boundary is not implied by generic algebraic geometry.

seed_details.seed: Sharp proximal average-treatment-effect bounds along latent-realizable Hall-null directions.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Intersect the algebraic bridge-null space with the tangent cone of positive latent factor tables before optimizing the causal loading.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may say existing proximal partial-identification programs already optimize over bridge nonuniqueness.
seed_details.rebuttal: The unresolved distinction is between algebraic bridge directions and directions realized by two compatible latent structural causal models on the declared support.

seed_details.seed: Treatment-bridge Hall frontier under heterogeneous proxy alphabets.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive the treatment-side fortified supply decomposition directly because reversing the conditional roles does not transpose the support incidence map.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may call the treatment result a notational transpose of the outcome route.
seed_details.rebuttal: The treatment bridge uses \(L^2(W,A)+L^2(C)\), so its block index, quotient null space, and factor dependencies differ on asymmetric supports.

seed_details.seed: Joint outcome-route and treatment-route support classification.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct both route-specific quotient polymatroids and determine whether their Hall-feasible support families are ordered or incomparable.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may say the four-way route classification is merely two separate completeness checks.
seed_details.rebuttal: A publishable version requires a structural theorem relating the two quotient polymatroids; absent such a relation the seed collapses to juxtaposition.

seed_details.seed: Distance to the determinantal exceptional locus as an actual-law weak-completeness index.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace generic nonvanishing by a smallest-singular-value margin and derive its sampling behavior under an estimated pairing matrix.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may say the smallest singular value is the standard weak-identification diagnostic.
seed_details.rebuttal: Without a support-adapted normalization and a new limit frontier, the objection holds; the literature scan did not reveal a defensible nonstandard index.

seed_details.seed: Minimum structural-support augmentation that eliminates every Hall defect.
seed_details.anchor: HiraiIwamasa2022; Edmonds-style matching direction recorded in the prior proposal.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Turn the deficient-set oracle into a cell-addition problem and prove an approximation or min--max certificate for the smallest augmentation.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may call support augmentation scientifically meaningless because structural zeros cannot be altered by design.
seed_details.rebuttal: The object is useful only when cells represent coarsening or measurement design choices; without that interpretation consumer value is too narrow.

seed_details.seed: Simultaneous Hall feasibility across every valid-proxy subset of size at least \(\gamma\).
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Intersect the route-specific determinantal open sets across all admissible \(\alpha\) and search for a common positive rational specialization.
seed_details.red_team: A cynical referee may say finitely many generic open sets automatically have nonempty intersection.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds on one irreducible shared parameter space once each component is nonempty, so this seed adds little beyond the single-component theorem.

novelty_justification: The closest causal result is Yu, Shi, and Tchetgen Tchetgen's fortified completeness assumption, whose finite example checks a matrix at a law but does not determine whether any compatible law on a structural support can satisfy it. The closest algebraic result is Rado's independent-transversal theorem, which supplies only the abstract all-subfamilies criterion. The new kernel constructs the symbolic fortified incidence space from \(S\), isolates the forced block-constant kernel \(\kappa_0(S)\), forms the quotient family \(W_y\), and proves that positive stochastic product blocks attain the Rado defect \(\eta(S)\) at a rational compatible table. This yields a support-only generic rank formula and a law-uniform impossibility statement that neither literature contains. Targeted searches for proximal completeness combined with Hall conditions, structural zeros, generic rank, and product-block stochastic matrices found no closer theorem. The algorithmic rung is not a bare invocation of submodular minimization because the exact rational-function rank oracle and its deficient-block interpretation are part of the theorem.
